card.name: Start of rare medical words: rhin-, brady-
card.fires_on: The first piece of a rare medical word that is split into parts, such as 'rh' in rhinorrhea and rhinitis, 'br' in bradykinin, and 'ach' in brachygnathia. It fires where the rest of the word must still be completed.

modes.label: rhin- words
modes.description: The 'rh' that begins rhinorrhea or rhinitis in symptom lists.

modes.label: brady- and brachy- words
modes.description: The 'br' or 'ach' that begins bradykinin or brachygnathia.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word with the expected continuation pieces, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening letters of a rare medical term like rhinorrhea or bradykinin, before the word is finished.
